# Control catalogs

The catalogs built into this version. Their content is indicative, pending legal review. Score counts the statuses in *counts as ready*; coverage is the share of in-scope controls that are assessable.

## EU AI Act 1.0.0 (`aiact@1.0.0`)

- Jurisdiction: EU; effective 2024-08-01; schema ^0.1
- Source: Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 (AI Act) (indicative, pending legal review; Milestone 8 scope)
- Counts as ready: ready, monitoring

| Control | Title | Rule | Requires | Evidence expected |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ai-inventory` | AI system inventory | records_exist on `cloud_resource` | cloud_resource.resource_ref | Inventory of cloud resources |
| `ai-provider` | Provider and hosting visibility | fields_complete on `cloud_resource` | cloud_resource.provider_key, cloud_resource.region | Cloud resources with provider and region |
| `ai-oversight` | Human oversight review | manual |  | Oversight procedure and review records |

## DORA 1.0.0 (`dora@1.0.0`)

- Jurisdiction: EU; effective 2025-01-17; schema ^0.1
- Source: Regulation (EU) 2022/2554 (DORA) and the ITS on the register of information (indicative, pending legal review)
- Counts as ready: ready, monitoring

| Control | Title | Rule | Requires | Evidence expected |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `dora-roi-reporting-entity` | Reporting entity is identified | fields_complete on `reporting_entity` | reporting_entity.lei, reporting_entity.name, reporting_entity.country, reporting_entity.entity_type, reporting_entity.competent_authority, reporting_entity.reporting_date | Reporting entity record with every register field |
| `dora-roi-provider-identification` | ICT third-party providers are identified | fields_complete on `ict_provider` | ict_provider.provider_id_code, ict_provider.provider_id_type, ict_provider.legal_name, ict_provider.person_type, ict_provider.hq_country | Provider master data for every ICT third-party service provider |
| `dora-roi-ultimate-parent` | Ultimate parent of each provider is known | references_resolved on `ict_provider` fields `parent_id_code` | ict_provider.parent_id_code | Ultimate parent identification per provider |
| `dora-roi-data-location` | Data location of ICT services is known | fields_complete on `arrangement_service_line` | arrangement_service_line.country_of_provision, arrangement_service_line.data_at_rest_country, arrangement_service_line.data_processing_country | Register lines with confirmed provision, storage and processing countries |
| `dora-roi-arrangement-dates` | Arrangement dates are recorded | fields_complete on `arrangement_service_line` | arrangement_service_line.start_date, arrangement_service_line.end_date | Contract start and end dates per service line |
| `dora-roi-signatories` | Arrangement signatories are recorded | records_exist on `arrangement_party` | arrangement_party.party_id_code | Signatory records per contractual arrangement |
| `dora-supply-chain-visibility` | ICT supply chains are recorded | records_exist on `supply_chain_link` | supply_chain_link.rank, supply_chain_link.recipient_id_code | Ranked subcontractor records per ICT service |
| `dora-function-criticality` | Functions have a criticality assessment | fields_complete on `function` | function.criticality_assessment, function.last_assessment_date, function.rto, function.rpo, function.discontinuing_impact | Criticality assessment per function |
| `dora-substitutability-assessed` | Substitutability of ICT services is assessed | fields_complete on `service_assessment` | service_assessment.substitutability, service_assessment.last_audit_date, service_assessment.reintegration_possibility, service_assessment.alternatives_identified | Substitutability assessment per ICT service |
| `dora-exit-plans` | Exit plans exist for assessed ICT services | field_equals on `service_assessment` `exit_plan_exists` = `true` | service_assessment.exit_plan_exists | Exit plan document per assessed ICT service |
| `dora-incident-readiness` | ICT incident management readiness | manual |  | Incident management procedure; Latest recovery test report |
